frame.name: disk
frame.definition: d = R (x_box_kpc - center_kpc); cube axes (i,j,k) = (x_d, y_d, z_d), z_d along Lhat

order: x-fastest: index = i + n*(j + n*k); voxel centre = -half_kpc + (i + 0.5) * voxel_kpc

webp.map: part p, slice k = 64p + s; pixel (x = (s % 16)*n + i, y = floor(s / 16)*n + j)

gz.star_raw: 4 n^3 bytes RGBA, A = 255 if R|G|B else 0

stars.units: L_AB0 kpc^-3 (L_AB0 = luminosity of an M_AB = 0 source)
